data.name: Whispering Spirits
data.description: The spiritualist can open a conduit with the spirit world that can aid him in combat for a short time. He can expend one use of his commune with spirits ability in order to gain a +%1 insight bonus to both AC and saving throws for 1 minute.|max(1,WIS)
